how_to_apply: Fill in the application and pay the prescribed fee online only, on JMI's portal https://jobs.jmi.ac.in, between 12 November 2026 and 11 December 2026. Submit a separate application for each post.
After successful submission, download the PDF version of the submitted Application Form and print it on A4-size paper.
Sign the printed form and paste a recent, front-facing photograph at the designated place.
Attach the self-attested copies of all documents claimed in the online application, listed below. Number them serially and endorse the serial numbers against the relevant entries in the hard copy.

If you are employed with a State/Central Govt., PSU or Autonomous Body, enclose a No Objection Certificate from your employer in the Annexure A format. Candidates already in service must apply through proper channel.
On the top-left side of the cover, write the Post applied for, the Advertisement Number and its date.

Send the hard copy (single copy) by speed post/courier, or hand it in personally, at: Recruitment & Promotion Section, 2nd Floor, Registrar's Office, Jamia Millia Islamia, Jamia Nagar, New Delhi-110025. It must reach by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Advt. No. 01/2026-27 (NT) lists 85 non-teaching posts across 35 positions, including 10 Upper Division Clerk (UDC) posts and 6 Beldar posts. The notice says the number is tentative and may be increased or decreased.

faq.question: Q2. When does the JMI Recruitment 2026 online application start?
faq.answer: Online applications on jobs.jmi.ac.in start on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application is 11 December 2026. The hard copy with documents must reach the Recruitment & Promotion Section, Registrar's Office, JMI by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Group A posts (Pay Level 10 and above), the fee is 1000 for UR/OBC and 500 for SC/ST. For Group B and C posts (Pay Level 7 and below), it is 700 for UR/OBC and 350 for SC/ST. PwBD (Divyangjan) candidates pay NIL in both groups.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JMI non-teaching posts 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for 32 posts. It is preferably below 56 years for Internal Audit Officer, Superintendent Engineer (Civil) and Executive Engineer (Civil). Age is reckoned as on 11 December 2026, and relaxation applies as per Central Govt. orders.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is required for JMI UDC 2026?
faq.answer: The UDC post requires a Bachelor's Degree and two years' experience as Lower Division Clerk or equivalent in a Central/State Govt. office, university or autonomous institution. Candidates also need English typing @ 35 wpm or Hindi/Urdu typing @ 30 wpm, and proficiency in computer operations.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary in JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Pay Level 1 (₹18,000 – 56,900) for posts such as Beldar and Wireman to Pay Level 13 (₹1,23,100 – 2,15,900) for Superintendent Engineer (Civil). The UDC post is at Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 – 81,100).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the written / skill / trade test / interview, etc., after shortlisting. For Assistant Registrar, it is an All India open competition with a Written Test and Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates who applied under Advt. No. 02/2025-26 (NT) need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. Earlier applicants for the posts marked * must apply afresh online. They are exempted from the fee on enclosing the original acknowledgement receipt or a valid post/courier slip, and they get age relaxation if they met the age limit on the last date of that advertisement.

faq.answer: Pay ranges from Pay Level 1 (₹18,000 – 56,900) for posts such as Beldar and Wireman to Pay Level 13 (₹1,23,100 – 2,15,900) for Superintendent Engineer (Civil). The UDC post is at Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 – 81,100).

faq.question: What is the selection process for JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the written / skill / trade test / interview, etc., after shortlisting. For Assistant Registrar, it is an All India open competition with a Written Test and Interview.

faq.question: Do candidates who applied under Advt. No. 02/2025-26 (NT) need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. Earlier applicants for the posts marked * must apply afresh online. They are exempted from the fee on enclosing the original acknowledgement receipt or a valid post/courier slip, and they get age relaxation if they met the age limit on the last date of that advertisement.
